candidate_record.claim: Users should be able to select an existing UI set and an evidence-bound runtime set by stable spoken IDs.
candidate_record.existing_asset: Existing Workflow, Capability, Engine-Adapter, Order-Work and GitHub handoff implementations are referenced rather than copied.
candidate_record.next_smallest_change: Validate the catalog and spoken selector, then obtain independent review before adoption.

authority.note: This catalog reuses existing contracts and evidence. Selecting a set never grants execution, deployment, data-write or external-send authority.

components.name: D Workflow Engine
components.implementation: Workflow transition, evidence, approval, idempotency, retry and audit decision engine.
components.permission_deployment_state: Core logic is adopted; project binding and production deployment remain separate.
hold_conditions: Required permission, evidence or approval is missing

components.name: Operating Capability Engine Wiring
components.implementation: Single host wiring for capability registry, project registry, trusted work sources and authority verification.
components.permission_deployment_state: ROUTING_ONLY without trusted workSources; factory never creates authority.
hold_conditions: Authority verifier is absent or stale

components.name: Capability Engine
components.implementation: Plans and invokes ACTIVE capability adapters with revision and authority gates.
components.permission_deployment_state: Only registered ACTIVE capabilities are candidates; external mutation still needs explicit authority.
hold_conditions: Capability or project is not registered/ACTIVE
Subject revision or authority is stale

components.name: Capability Execution Coordinator
components.implementation: Durable request reservation, immutable identity, result reconciliation and terminal receipt recording.
components.permission_deployment_state: Coordinator records decisions/results but does not independently grant execution authority.
hold_conditions: Terminal receipt or exact revision is missing

components.name: Order to Work Read Adapter
components.implementation: Reads and validates immutable order-to-work mapping and prepares review commands without sending them.
components.permission_deployment_state: sent, execution_authorized and completion_authorized remain false.

components.name: FreePass ERP4 Firestore Path Adapter
components.implementation: Firestore-only path adapter with document/batch/transaction mapping and no alternate-database fallback.
components.permission_deployment_state: Implementation exists on current remote main; exact production binding, credentials and deployed revision are not established by this catalog.

components.name: FreePass Admin File Application Adapter
components.implementation: Atomic JSON file repository used for development and verification only.

components.name: FreePass Sales Customer Search Adapter
components.implementation: Read-only exact-match customer lookup with masked result projection and fail-closed source errors.
components.permission_deployment_state: Read-only capability; live credential/service availability must be rechecked per run.
hold_conditions: Sales source or credential connection fails

components.name: Welrix Quote Provider Adapter
components.implementation: Provider-specific request/result mapping including percent-to-decimal conversion and fail-closed provider errors.
components.permission_deployment_state: Remote implementation exists; live provider parity and production binding are separate checks.
hold_conditions: Live provider parity is not checked
Target authority is not FreePass Estimate/Welrix bounded integration

components.name: Firestore Repository
components.implementation: Firestore collection/document persistence with atomic batch and transaction boundaries.
components.permission_deployment_state: Repository is project-owned; no cross-project production authority is inferred.
hold_conditions: Write authority or rollback evidence is missing

components.name: Local JSON File Repository
components.implementation: Local durable JSON repository with atomic mutation semantics.

components.name: AI Core Order SQLite Repository
components.implementation: Local durable order intake and capability execution request/result persistence.
components.permission_deployment_state: Order intake is not canonical business completion or external execution authority.
hold_conditions: Used as a substitute for project business SSOT

components.name: GitHub Work and Evidence Connector
components.implementation: Read-only repository revision/tree inspection plus privacy-checked handoff/proposal packets.
components.permission_deployment_state: No automatic push, merge, deployment, claim or execution authority.
hold_conditions: GitHub revision cannot be read back

components.name: Firebase Firestore Provider
components.implementation: Firestore provider boundary; exact project, credentials and rules remain project-owned.
components.permission_deployment_state: No credential, rules or deployment authority is granted by catalog selection.

components.name: GitHub Provider
components.implementation: GitHub API provider used for exact revision and repository evidence reads.
components.permission_deployment_state: Read access does not imply write, merge, release or deployment authority.

components.name: Welrix Quote Provider
components.permission_deployment_state: Provider contract change and production deployment require explicit approval.

runtime_sets.name: 표준 웹업무
runtime_sets.actual_implementation: Core engines and GitHub evidence connector are implemented. Firestore adapter/repository is verified as an ERP4 project implementation only; Admin production binding is absent and Sales has a separate read-only adapter.
runtime_sets.permission_deployment_state: No production binding or deployment is authorized.
hold_conditions: Choose an exact target project and revision

runtime_sets.name: 조회·모니터링
runtime_sets.actual_implementation: Sales exact-match lookup and AI Core ACTIVE read-only capabilities exist. A generic cross-project Firestore reader does not.
runtime_sets.permission_deployment_state: Read-only intent; project credentials and minimum-data projection must be rechecked per run.
hold_conditions: Target read adapter is not registered/ACTIVE
Credentials or live source are unavailable
Query would expose unneeded personal data

runtime_sets.name: 문서생성
runtime_sets.actual_implementation: Local file persistence and GitHub handoff exist, but the DocsHub production capability is HOLD and no generic document-generation adapter is ACTIVE in AI Core.
runtime_sets.permission_deployment_state: Local/SHADOW drafting only; external distribution remains separately approved.

runtime_sets.name: AI 협업·GitHub 인계
runtime_sets.actual_implementation: Order/work mapping, durable result coordination, GitHub inspection and privacy-checked handoff packets exist.
runtime_sets.permission_deployment_state: Selection and handoff do not grant claim, execute, merge, deploy, send or completion authority.
hold_conditions: GitHub readback or CI evidence is missing
